mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LISTING ( LSTG_ID, MBR_CD, RENTAL_PTY_ID, LSTG_TYPE_CODE1, LSTG_TYPE_CODE2, LSTG_ADD, LSTG_ADD2, LSTG_EX_AREA, LSTG_GR_AREA, LSTG_ROOM_CNT, LSTG_ROOM_NUM, LSTG_NM, LSTG_DST, LSTG_TYPE_SALE, LSTG_LEASE, LSTG_LEASE_M, LSTG_LEASE_AMT, LSTG_FLOOR, LSTG_PARK_YN, LSTG_LAT, LSTG_LNG, LSTG_DEL, LSTG_REG_DATE, LSTG_PROD_STAT, LSTG_POSTAL, LSTG_FEE ) VALUES ( #{lstgId}, #{mbrCd}, #{rentalPtyId}, #{lstgTypeCode1}, #{lstgTypeCode2}, #{lstgAdd}, #{lstgAdd2}, #{lstgExArea}, #{lstgGrArea}, #{lstgRoomCnt}, #{lstgRoomNum}, #{lstgNm}, #{lstgDst}, #{lstgTypeSale}, #{lstgLease}, #{lstgLeaseM}, #{lstgLeaseAmt}, #{lstgFloor}, #{lstgParkYn}, #{lstgLat}, #{lstgLng}, 'N', SYSDATE, '001', #{lstgPostal}, #{lstgFee} )
mapper.select: SELECT LSTG_ID , MBR_CD , LSTG_TYPE_CODE2 , LSTG_ADD , LSTG_ADD2 , LSTG_EX_AREA , LSTG_GR_AREA , LSTG_ROOM_CNT , LSTG_ROOM_NUM , LSTG_DST , LSTG_TYPE_SALE , LSTG_LEASE , LSTG_LEASE_M , LSTG_LEASE_AMT , LSTG_FLOOR , LSTG_PARK_YN , LSTG_LAT , LSTG_LNG , LSTG_DEL , LSTG_REG_DATE , LSTG_PROD_STAT , LSTG_NM , LSTG_TYPE_CODE1 , RENTAL_PTY_ID , LSTG_POSTAL , LSTG_FEE FROM LISTING WHERE LSTG_ADD = #{lstgAdd} AND RENTAL_PTY_ID = #{rentalPtyId} AND LSTG_DEL = 'N'
